Hi Emma / Acme team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I promised to share a concise starter MAP (mutual action plan) you can use to align internal stakeholders and a one-page slide for execs. Attached is a seeded Google Doc that breaks the plan into: week 0 intake, week 1 infra readiness, week 2–3 technical validation, week 4 acceptance checks, and go/no-go gating.

Two quick asks to tailor this:
- Can you share a short stakeholder roster (names + roles + availability for a 30-min sync)?
- Do you have an internal acceptance metric we should validate in the 30–60 day trial (e.g., latency <200ms on sampled traffic, F1 > 0.85 on the eval set, or other business KPI)?

I've also added a proposed timeline below (very flexible):
- Week 0: kickoff + account admin + access
- Week 1: infra & network readiness (KMS, VPC peering, test dataset prep)
- Week 2–3: integration + eval scenarios + ops runbook
- Week 4: acceptance run & retrospective + next steps

Links / attachments:
- decision-track-map-template.gdoc (starter MAP) — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHIj-klmnopQRsTUvWxYz/edit
- map-one-pager.pdf (1-slide summary) — attached

Proposed sync: Thu 11/4 10:00–10:30 PT (open to other times)

If that works I will lock the calendar and share an updated GDoc with lanes for each of your stakeholders.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
